k.description: k: optional, int, default=0. Specifies the sub-diagonal above which the elements of the array are set to zero. ``k=0`` refers to main diagonal, ``k<0`` refers to sub-diagonal below the main diagonal and ``k>0`` refers to sub-diagonal above the main diagonal.

output.description: An array with same shape as input containing the lower triangle of the given array with elements above the sub-diagonal specified by ``k`` are set to zero.
